tools.name: me_human_verify_result
tools.description: Retrieve or briefly wait for an existing Human Verify result without another payment. Use only the private status_url returned by me_human_verify. It is a bearer credential: keep it private. Polling is bounded, at most once every five seconds; if still pending, call again after retry_after_seconds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: me_human_verify · Private data: me_human_verify, me_human_verify_result, me_discover, me_purchase_status, me_get_supply_plan, me_get_provider_tasks, me_resolution_contract, me_resolve_blocker · Public sink: me_human_verify, me_submit_outcome, me_license_capability_asset, me_resolve_blocker · Destructive: me_purchase_challenge, me_purchase_execute, me_resolve, me_approval, me_qa_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: me_human_verify · Private data: me_human_verify, me_human_verify_result, me_discover, me_purchase_status, me_get_supply_plan, me_get_provider_tasks, me_resolution_contract, me_resolve_blocker · Public sink: me_human_verify, me_submit_outcome, me_license_capability_asset, me_resolve_blocker · Destructive: me_purchase_challenge, me_purchase_execute, me_resolve, me_approval, me_qa_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
